# Film Storyboards

> > Professional storyboarding and visual storytelling services based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, specializing in feature films, commercials, and animation projects across Southeast Asia and Europe.

Film Storyboards is a freelance storyboard studio offering pre-production visualization services for film, television, and advertising clients. The portfolio showcases work for feature films like The Hot Potato, commercial campaigns for brands like Toyota, and animation projects for organizations including the European Commission.
